sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The "Overseas Educational Loan Scheme" objective is to provide financial/loan assistance to students belonging to minority communities who are pursuing graduate or postgraduate degree courses in recognized universities abroad.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Loan

**Detailed Description:** The "Overseas Educational Loan Scheme" was launched by the Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka, and implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme objective is to provide financial/loan assistance to students belonging to minority communities who are pursuing graduate or postgraduate degree courses in recognized universities abroad.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - The loan amount will be provided up to ₹20,00,000/- at a zero interest rate.

**Application Process:** Step-01: Applicant need to visits the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation[ official website](https://kmdconline.karnataka.gov.in/Portal/home). Step-02: Click ["Apply Online"](https://kmdconline.karnataka.gov.in/Portal/login) and Enter "Mobile Number" and "Submit". Step-03: Enter "Aadhaar Number" Fill in the "Captcha&quot
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation; Nodal Department: Minorities Welfare Department
